frozenFor: docs/DECISIONS.md D-077 (GLP-1R QSAR efficacy axis) — sealed BEFORE any human GLP-1R activity data was pulled or trained on
fingerprintMethod: provenance.mjs::canonicalHash(gate).slice(0,16) — derived from the `gate` object below ONLY, so editing any field changes this value

rationale.MIN_TRAIN: 150 is a conservative floor for a 512-bit ridge model on a single congeneric-ish target class; below it, coefficients are dominated by the lambda=1.0 prior rather than the data.
rationale.MIN_TEST: 40 held-out compounds is the smallest set this project accepts a scaffold-split MAE/R2 estimate from without it being dominated by 1-2 outlier scaffolds.
rationale.MAX_MAE: 1.0 pActivity unit (~10x in raw potency) is the outer bound of a QSAR estimate this project will call 'validated' rather than 'noise'.
rationale.MIN_R2: 0.25 is a low but non-trivial bar: it rules out a model no better than predicting the training mean, without pretending a small, single-target dataset should clear a high-R2 bar tuned for larger public benchmarks.

changeRequiresNewDEntry: any edit to `gate` (including relaxing a threshold after seeing a training run's numbers) invalidates ruleFingerprint and requires a new DECISIONS.md D-entry, per the same rule D-069/D-074 already established for frozen-prediction-thresholds.json
